description: This file defines the 'Desc' struct and associated functions for creating and managing metric descriptors in the Prometheus client library. It includes methods for constructing descriptors with labels, validation, and string representation.

classes.name: Desc
classes.description: Represents the immutable metadata of a Prometheus metric, including name, help text, labels, and hashes for identification.

methods.name: NewDesc
methods.description: Creates a new metric descriptor with specified name, help, labels, and constant labels, performing validation and hashing.

methods.name: NewInvalidDesc
methods.description: Creates a descriptor marked with an error, used to signal invalid descriptors.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the descriptor, including labels.
